title: Wedding: guest lists, and who added what
items: Guest list tab: a list of names for each of you. Type a name and press Enter, or paste a whole list
“Ali Demir +1” counts as 2, “Kaya family x4” as 4. The total is counted against your places and the venue
Every wedding to-do and every guest says who added it
Choose who the to-dos you add are for: no one yet, one of you, or both of you
The Personal side is now in your own colour: blue for Umit, pink for Dilfiraz

title: Attach files to tasks
items: Open a task and tap Attach: PDF, Word, Excel, photos or anything else, up to 25 MB each
You can also attach files while creating a task
Whoever can see the task can open, download and delete its files. A 📎 shows how many it has
Photos open in Backstage; other files open in your browser

title: Events: choose the calendar and who can see it
items: Every event now asks which calendar it goes on: Work, Personal, Joint or Wedding
And who can see it: only you, or the other person too
An event you share shows on the other person’s calendar in your colour. They can read it but not change it
Events only you can see are still never sent to the other person

title: Two sides: Work and Personal
items: A switch at the top: Work or Personal. Each side has its own Today page, tasks, projects and calendar
Work shows only work things. Nothing personal, joint or wedding appears there, and hearts and messages wait until you switch back
Each device remembers its side. A browser starts on Work, the phone app on Personal
Every project is a Work or a Personal one: choose when you create it. Change it later and its tasks move with it
Your own calendar entries can be marked Work; only those show on the Work calendar

title: Wedding planner: countdown, guests, budget and areas
items: Set the wedding date and venue: a countdown appears, and the day goes on the joint calendar
Guests: the venue’s capacity against how many each of you is inviting, with places left
Areas: Venue, Catering, Decor and ten more to start with. Add your own, rename or remove any
Tap an area to see just its to-dos; new to-dos go into the area you are looking at
Budget: an overall figure, a share for each area, and what has been spent so far
Not sure where to begin? One tap adds the usual to-dos for each area

title: Wedding planning, and calendars that are really yours
items: New Wedding section: one shared list of everything to do for the wedding. You both see and change all of it
A wedding to-do can be left with no one on it, or given to Umit, Dilfiraz or both
Wedding to-dos and wedding dates are gold everywhere: on Today, on the calendar and in their own section
Any joint to-do can be turned into a wedding one from its edit screen (List › Wedding)
Calendars: the joint calendar is for both of you; your own calendar is now seen only by you. The other person no longer sees “Busy” blocks

title: Live: see each other’s changes as they happen
items: When one of you adds, ticks off, moves, edits or deletes a task, it changes on the other’s screen within about 3 seconds. No refreshing
The same goes for the calendar, projects, shopping list, dinner and dates, and chat
A short note tells you what changed on the joint list: “✓ Dilfiraz ticked off…”, “Umit added…”
A task open for editing follows along too, and never overwrites the other person’s newer text
In a browser with notifications switched on, you also get a notification when a joint to-do is ticked off or handed to you

title: Dates game: swipe to pick your next date
items: Us › Dates now works like Dinner: you both swipe the same 50 date ideas, left for yes, right for no
The first idea you both say yes to pops up for both of you as “It’s a date!”
Book it for Saturday straight from the pop-up
Your own date ideas go to the front of the deck; dinner and dates are played separately

title: Hearts on every screen
items: A heart from the other person now floats up whichever screen you are on, even with a task or sheet open
Hearts and messages arrive within about 5 seconds, and no longer get missed when you move between screens
A heart sent while Backstage was closed shows when you next open it
Hearts still show on phones that have animations switched off

title: Dinner match, shown to both of you
items: When you both say yes to the same dish, each of you gets a pop-up with the dish, wherever you are in Backstage
In a browser with notifications switched on, the other person also gets a notification when Backstage is closed
Made a match while the other was away? They see it the next time they open Backstage
If you match on more than one dish, you both see the same one: the first you agreed on

title: Cleaner Backstage
items: Every task now has a pencil to edit it and a bin to delete it. Deleted by mistake? Tap Undo
Whatever you type in an Add box is one task, however long it is. It is no longer split up
Editing a task is simpler: Mark as done at the top, Delete and Save always in reach at the bottom
New task asks for the basics first; reminder, project, notes and repeat sit under More options
One blue + button on the phone, and tasks come first on Today
Removed: speaking tasks, the calendar link option and the Add to calendar button

title: A video, just once
items: Umit can send Dilfiraz a video from his Today screen. It plays once, full screen, then it’s deleted for good
Dilfiraz gets a gift card and a buzz when a video is waiting; Umit sees when it has been watched
Videos up to 150 MB, with a few words to go with them

title: Feel each other’s day
items: When the other person changes how their day is going, a card pops up in the app with a one-tap heart
Your phone buzzes for hearts (two heartbeats), mood changes and new messages
Bigger ‘thinking of you’ heart button and bigger floating hearts
Browser notifications for mood changes too

title: Private app page
items: The app download and updates pages now ask for a password
Signed in to Backstage on the device? They open straight away

title: 50 date ideas, 50 dishes, all on umitbozdag.com
items: Date roulette now spins through 50 date ideas plus your own
Dinner game deck is now 50 dishes
Calendar links, download links and the app's web address now all use umitbozdag.com
Sign-in screen: just your name and password

title: Dinner game with 58 dishes
items: Dinner game: swipe through 58 dishes together. Left for yes ✓, right for no ✕. First dish you both like wins
Your own dinner ideas go to the front of the deck
A 'What's new' card after each update, and a notification to both of you when a new version goes live
Sign-in screen tidied up

title: Newest app always on the download page
items: Every update now publishes a fresh Android app on umitbozdag.com/app automatically
The download page shows the version, date and what's new
Already installed? The app updates itself, no reinstall needed
New Updates page with every feature and its date

title: Always up to date, browser notifications
items: Backstage reloads itself when a new version goes live, also inside the app.
Browser notifications for messages, hearts, nudges and new joint things (Chrome).

title: Just for the two of us
items: Mood check-ins, countdowns, chore battle with a crown, birthday heads-up.
Us tab: chat, dinner swipe, date roulette, memory jar, private gift ideas.
Shopping list in Joint, love notes and nudges on joint to-dos, hearts.

title: Chat, help and clearer errors
items: Chat between Umit and Dilfiraz with Seen and hearts.
Welcome guide, 'How Backstage works', offline banner and friendlier errors.

title: Backstage for two
items: Sign in as Umit or Dilfiraz; your own lists plus a joint list and calendar.
Calendar with events, Busy blocks and a Google Calendar link; phone layout with bottom tabs.
